otp.preview: Your peopleeat sign-in code: {code} (expires in 10 minutes)
otp.subject: Your peopleeat sign-in code: {code}
otp.body: Enter this code on the sign-in page. It expires in ten minutes.

accountDelete.subject: Code to delete your account
accountDelete.body: Enter this code on the account page to confirm deletion. It expires in ten minutes. If this was not you, ignore this email.

emailUpdate.preview: Confirm your new email address. Code: {code}
emailUpdate.subject: Confirm your new email address
emailUpdate.body: Enter this code on the account page to confirm your new email address. It expires in ten minutes.

common.questionsBefore: Feel free to contact us at
common.questionsAfter: anytime with questions or concerns. Our team is always happy to help.
common.calendarRemovalEvening: If you saved the evening, please remove it from your calendar.
common.calendarRemovalSlot: If you saved this, please remove it from your calendar.
common.calendarFileDayBefore: A calendar file is attached. The time is the start, and it reminds you the day before.

details.heading: Booking details
details.feesNote: Please note that travel costs and service fees may apply in addition.

cancellation.heading: Cancellation policy
cancellation.before: Free cancellation is possible until the request is accepted and up to two weeks before the event. Later cancellations may incur fees. If you need to change your reservation, please contact us as early as possible so we can help. You can find more information in our

create.previewPool: Your request is in. Chefs nearby are preparing menus
create.intro: Thank you for your request! This confirms that we have received it.
create.stepDirectMenu: {cookName} will look at your request for “{menuTitle}” and send you an offer.
create.stepDirect: {cookName} will look at your request and send you an offer.
create.stepDirectOpen: You can open it to other chefs nearby at any time.
create.stepDirectChat: After booking, you can chat with the chef.
create.stepPoolMenus: Chefs near you will prepare menu proposals.
create.stepPoolNotify: You will be notified as soon as new proposals arrive.
create.stepPoolAdjust: You can request adjustments at any time.
create.stepPoolChat: After booking, you can chat with the chef.
create.statusNote: You can check the status of your request at any time.
create.subject: Booking request

directNeedsExpansion.preview: {requestedCookFirstName} can't make it this time. Your request is still here.
directNeedsExpansion.body: {requestedCookFirstName} can't make it this time. Your request is still here. Get offers from other chefs nearby.
directNeedsExpansion.cta: Also get offers from other chefs
directNeedsExpansion.subject: {requestedCookFirstName} can't make it this time

update.preview: Please review: {customerFirstName} updated the booking request
update.body: {customerFirstName} updated the booking request. Please review the changes and re-confirm your offer if you still want to cook for this event.
update.dateNote: The date has changed and is not confirmed again yet. Please remove the old evening from your calendar.
update.subject: Booking request updated

cancelCustomer.preview: Your cancellation is confirmed. We're here when you're ready again
cancelCustomer.body: Sorry to see you cancel your request. We hope it works out next time. We're here whenever you'd like a private chef again.
cancelCustomer.closing: All the best, see you soon!
cancelCustomer.subject: Cancellation

cancelCook.preview: A request was withdrawn. New opportunities await in the pool
cancelCook.intro: A booking request you had offered on was withdrawn. Your offer is no longer valid.
cancelCook.closing: Keep an eye on the booking request pool so you don't miss new opportunities. We'll also email you about new requests in your area.
cancelCook.subject: Request was canceled

cooksNotify.previewDirect: A guest requested you (“{occasion}”): propose a menu now
cooksNotify.previewPool: New request in {city} (“{occasion}”): propose a menu now
cooksNotify.introDirectMenu: A guest requested you from your chef profile for “{menuTitle}” (“{occasion}” on {when} in {city}).
cooksNotify.introDirect: A guest requested you from your chef profile (“{occasion}” on {when} in {city}).
cooksNotify.introPool: Good news: a new booking request in {city} is available (“{occasion}” on {when}).
cooksNotify.nudge: Create a menu proposal now so the customer can accept quickly. We recommend responding within the next hour.

calendarDateMoved.preview: The date has changed. Please remove the old evening from your calendar
calendarDateMoved.body: The date has changed and is not confirmed again yet. Please remove the old evening from your calendar.
calendarDateMoved.subject: Booking date changed

calendarRestored.preview: The evening is confirmed. The calendar file is attached
calendarRestored.body: {occasion} · {when}. The evening is confirmed. A calendar file is attached. The time is the start. If you saved the old evening, please replace it with this file.
calendarRestored.subject: Evening confirmed again

create.preview: Chef {cookFirstName} sent you a menu proposal. Take a look
create.intro: Good news: Chef {cookFirstName} sent you an offer with a menu proposal.
create.subject: You received an offer

menusUpdate.preview: Chef {cookFirstName} updated your menu based on your wishes
menusUpdate.intro: Good news: Chef {cookFirstName} updated the menu in your offer based on your feedback.
menusUpdate.subject: Offer menu was updated

acceptCook.preview: Great news: {customerFirstName} accepted your menu proposal
acceptCook.intro: Great news! {customerFirstName} accepted your menu proposal. You can now sort out the remaining details together in chat on peopleeat.
acceptCook.nudge: Reach out to the customer soon so you can align on everything important for the event.
acceptCook.subject: Offer was accepted

acceptNotChosen.preview: This request went to another chef. New ones near you are coming
acceptNotChosen.intro: {customerFirstName} chose another private chef. This request is no longer available.
acceptNotChosen.closing: Don't worry: new requests near you will show up soon. Keep an eye on the pool and respond quickly to land your next booking.
acceptNotChosen.subject: Request went to another chef

declineCook.preview: {customerFirstName} didn't choose your offer. New requests await
declineCook.intro: {customerFirstName} decided not to go ahead with your offer.
declineCook.closing: Don't worry: there will be many more opportunities. Keep an eye on the booking request pool. We'll also email you when new requests come in.
declineCook.subject: Offer was declined

amendmentCreate.preview: {customerFirstName} wants to change the number of participants
amendmentCreate.body: {customerFirstName} proposed a change to the number of participants. Please review the proposal and accept or decline it. The booking stays unchanged until you decide.
amendmentCreate.subject: Participant change proposed

amendmentAccept.giftCardCredit: Unused credit was restored to your gift card.
amendmentAccept.payDifference: Please complete the difference payment in checkout.
amendmentAccept.checkoutUpdated: Your checkout was updated. Please complete payment.
amendmentAccept.laterChargeUpdated: The amount for the later card charge was updated.
amendmentAccept.refund: The difference will be refunded to you.
amendmentAccept.chargeSavedMethod: The difference will be charged to your saved payment method.
amendmentAccept.body: {cookFirstName} accepted your booking change.{moneyNote} You can see the updated details on your offer.
amendmentAccept.venueNote: The address has changed: {venue}. Please update it in your calendar.
amendmentAccept.subject: Booking change accepted

amendmentDecline.body: {cookFirstName} declined your proposed participant change. The booking stays unchanged. You can reach out in chat if you want to discuss it.
amendmentDecline.subject: Participant change declined

finalize.preview: Your booking with {cookFirstName} is confirmed. Here's what's next
finalize.heading: Your booking with {cookFirstName} is confirmed!
finalize.intro: Great choice on {cookFirstName}'s menu! It will be an unforgettable experience. We're glad you're in. You can now discuss all remaining details directly with the chef.
finalize.receiptNote: A payment receipt is also attached. It is not an invoice. The cook invoices you directly for the catering.
finalize.subject: Booking confirmation

statement.preview: Your payout amount and the peopleeat fee we withheld
statement.body: The booking ({occasion}) is paid. Your statement is attached, with the menu, travel, the peopleeat fee, and the payout. It is not an invoice. Please invoice the guest for the menu and travel.
statement.subject: Statement for your booking

pullAnnouncement.preview: Your event is coming up: {amount} will be charged on {when}
pullAnnouncement.intro: We've reserved a payment for your event. Because your event is coming up soon, we'll charge the amount on {when}.
pullAnnouncement.why: This lets the chef buy groceries and other supplies for your event ahead of time.
pullAnnouncement.cardNote: Please make sure your card has sufficient funds and does not expire before the charge date. If you'd like to update the card we'll charge, please get in touch with us.
pullAnnouncement.subject: We'll charge your card soon

request.preview: {senderFirstName} wants to meet you on a video call. Confirm the time
request.intro: {senderFirstName} would like to schedule a video call with you to get to know each other and discuss the event details. Please confirm or decline the proposed time.
request.subject: New video call request

confirm.preview: {accepterFirstName} confirmed your video call. You're all set
confirm.reminderNote: You will receive a reminder with the video call link 60 minutes before it starts.
confirm.calendarNote: A calendar file is attached. It reminds you 15 minutes before.
confirm.subject: Your video call was confirmed

decline.preview: {declinerFirstName} can't make that time. Feel free to propose another
decline.nextStep: Feel free to request a new time.
decline.subject: Your video call could not be confirmed

cancel.preview: {cancelerFirstName} canceled the video call. Schedule a new time
cancel.nextStep: Feel free to schedule a new time.
cancel.subject: Video call canceled

reminder.preview: Your video call with {counterpartyFirstName} starts in 60 minutes. Link inside
reminder.intro: Your video call with {counterpartyFirstName} starts in 60 minutes.
reminder.joinNote: We hope you have a great conversation! Use the link below to join the call:
reminder.subject: Reminder: video call in 60 minutes

notify.intro: you received a new message from {senderFirstName}.
notify.heading: You have a new message!
notify.preview: New message from {senderFirstName}. Read it in chat
notify.subject: There is a new message on one of your offers.

memory.preview: Your event with {counterpartyFirstName} is on. Capture memories for later
memory.bodyCustomer: Your event with {counterpartyFirstName} is underway. Photos and notes make leaving a review easier later.
memory.bodyCook: Your event with {counterpartyFirstName} is underway. Jot down a few impressions for later.
memory.subject: Capture memories from your event

review.previewEvening: Reminder: how was your event with {counterpartyFirstName}?
review.previewMorning: How was your event with {counterpartyFirstName}? Leave a short review
review.bodyCustomer: How was your event with {counterpartyFirstName}? A short review helps other guests.
review.bodyCook: How was your event with {counterpartyFirstName}? A short review helps us improve the platform.

pay.preview: Your {amount} gift card for {recipient} is ready
pay.body: Thank you for your purchase. The {amount} gift card for {recipient} is valid until {expiry}.
pay.attachments: Attached you will find the printable gift card (to share) and the purchase receipt.
pay.subject: Your peopleeat gift card

create.preview: Your support request is in. We will reply in chat
create.intro: Thank you for your message. We received your support request and will reply in chat as soon as we can.
create.subject: Support request received

reply.preview: New reply on your support request. Read it in chat
reply.intro: Our team replied to your support request. Open the chat to read the message.
reply.subject: New support reply

resolve.preview: Your support request is resolved. Reply anytime if you still need help
resolve.intro: We marked your support request as resolved. If anything is still open, just reply in chat, and that reopens the request.
resolve.subject: Support request resolved

approval.preview: Your chef profile is approved. Next up: wallet and visibility
approval.intro: Good news: our team approved your chef profile. You can now set up your wallet and make yourself visible to customers.
approval.nudge: Open your profile to see the next step.
approval.subject: Your chef profile was approved
